page: Amazon Web Services g6.4xlarge is a graphics-intensive instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor with 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores operating at 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU with 22 GB of VRAM, and 600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network performance is anchored by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% in stress-ng tests, while multi-core CPU and general memory bandwidth benchmarks fall into the average range. Notably, large-block memory write bandwidth is a relative bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25%. The instance excels in machine learning tasks, achieving top-tier performance in LLM inference speeds for prompt processing and text generation using small and medium models, alongside strong prompt processing for large models.

Given its hardware profile, the g6.4xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring moderate GPU acceleration without the overhead of larger multi-GPU systems. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, local NVMe SSD storage, and an NVIDIA L4 GPU makes this instance highly suitable for LLM inference, graphics-intensive rendering, machine learning model deployment, and video transcoding.
